are_you_ok.title: Sudden downpour strands drivers, prompts rescue efforts
are_you_ok.summary: Forecasters warned of flash flooding across Colorado, with the sharpest risk in burn scar areas — hillsides stripped by past wildfires, where rain runs off instead of soaking in. Severe thunderstorms then dropped heavy rain and hail on Denver and the eastern plains, leaving roads and trails muddy and prompting flood warnings across parts of the Denver metro area. One sudden downpour stranded drivers in their vehicles and pulled in rescue crews, with a fire battalion chief describing every call dropping at once.
are_you_ok.description: "All the calls dropped at the same time," fire Battalion Chief Jason Haley said. "Pretty much everybody was just stuck in their vehicles and couldn't get out."
questions: Did the downpour cause any trouble where you are?
Has the rain been affecting your commute at all?
